question: Is the 1993-01 to 2024-12 U.S. monthly momentum-factor mean positive under weak-dependence inference?

tasks.title: Freeze estimand, sample, and falsifiers
tasks.acceptance: Dates, units, HAC lags, block length, seed, and release conditions are fixed before analysis.

tasks.title: Download and analyze the fixed momentum sample
tasks.acceptance: The archive vintage is hashed; all 384 months are present; descriptive, HAC, bootstrap, split, trim, and leave-one-year-out results are emitted.

tasks.title: Audit interpretation and unsupported extrapolations
tasks.acceptance: The audit separates historical mean, weak-dependence inference, tradability, alpha, causality, and persistence.

tasks.title: Calibrate the final verdict
tasks.acceptance: The verdict follows the predeclared interval and sensitivity gates even if the sample mean is positive.
tasks.note: Result calibrated without upgrading a positive point estimate to significance.

sources.citation: Kenneth R. French Data Library, Momentum Factor (Mom), monthly CSV archive.
sources.note: The executable records the downloaded archive SHA-256 and available date range.
